title: VIXEN standalone configure should discover the paired Undertow root
body: A fresh VIXEN configure failed at VIXEN/libraries/Text/CMakeLists.txt:5 until the worker manually exported UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow/.claude-worktrees/pair-hlsl. The facade/build setup should provision or discover the compatible Undertow dependency for VIXEN validation.

title: VIXEN runtime witnesses should expose the complete Vulkan loader environment
body: Direct VIXEN capture-process witnesses first failed with VK_ERROR_INCOMPATIBLE_DRIVER until the worker copied VK_ICD_FILENAMES, VK_LAYER_PATH, and LD_LIBRARY_PATH from CTest's generated environment. The test/build facade should expose one reusable runtime environment for standalone capture producers.

title: Queued VIXEN configure should emit an authoritative completion status
body: The first queued VIXEN configure invocation returned without build/wsl/CMakeCache.txt or an authoritative completion marker; only transient /proc diagnostics were visible, so the worker had to retry before the actual UNDERTOW_ROOT diagnostic surfaced. The queue/build facade should preserve a durable status and diagnostic for admitted configure jobs.
